{"text":"# Model Overview (for Diagnosis)
The supplied adapter diagnoses a GRU4Rec model through ModelView. Relevant hooks are `item_emb`, `log2feats(sequence)` and `predict_score(features, items)`. Sequence features have shape B × L × D. Replay selects the final nonpadding position explicitly, preserving left-padding semantics. The audit describes a GRU initialized at zero on each call that still processes leading padding; the backbone implementation is not included here.

# Diagnosis Inputs & Hooks
`DiagnosisProbe(view, device)` stores ModelView and its metadata, review-data and training-history references. `run_full_diagnosis` caches up to ten loader batches containing sequence, positive and negative tensors. It temporarily sets the actual `view.model` to evaluation mode, runs without gradients, and restores its original mode. IDs, tensor shapes and finite scores are checked.

# Probes & Metrics
- **Embedding geometry:** Samples up to 2,048 real-item embeddings with seed 42 and maps mean off-diagonal cosine to [0,1]. Higher values indicate greater directional alignment; 0.5 means mean cosine zero. This alone cannot establish collapse or recommendation diversity.
- **Training-pair margins:** Computes positive-minus-negative logits at valid positions. Reports mean, tenth percentile, negative-outranking rate and margin-below-0.5 rate. Larger positive margins and fewer ranking errors indicate stronger sampled training separation, although margin magnitudes depend on score scale. Category lists remain empty because category metadata is unavailable.

# Perturbation & Tests
For eligible prefixes with at least four items, replay holds positive/negative candidates fixed while deleting recent, old, recent-nonfinal or final positions; retaining only the final item; and keeping suffixes. Matched random deletion controls use five draws per row. Conditions report pairwise wins, changes from original, state cosine distances and final-item retention/change flags.

Execution checks compare repeated calls, reversed batch order, batched versus single replay, and padded versus unpadded replay on one eligible history. Deletion changes leading-padding updates, so recency conclusions are explicitly withheld.

# MODEL_DIAGNOSIS Schema & Limitations
Raw output contains `metrics` and `metric_definitions`. Metrics include embedding geometry, margin summaries/counts and nested `history_sensitivity` conditions, paired differences, skip counts and execution audits. The interpreter requests JSON with status, core findings, implications and metric evidence.

These are descriptive training-prefix measurements, not validation HR@10 or improvement estimates. Anonymous rows may overweight frequent users; user-level uncertainty and exported-predictor agreement are unavailable. No unavailable metadata, user intent or simulator traits can be inferred."}
